name: Nyancrement
storyline: A cat has wandered into the Between, a mysterious realm where things from countless worlds drift in. To return home, it needs 10 billion Coins. Grimoire shows the cat a way home and stays by its side as it gathers Coins, strengthens Relics, and encounters mysterious Shadow Cats in the temple.
summary: Nyancrement is an incremental game about a cat that has wandered into a mysterious world. Collect coins with cat punches, strengthen relics, and steadily increase the value of each punch while working toward the 10 billion coins needed to return home.
